hotspots.title: Nigel Farage’s racial rhetoric sparks UK outrage
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage faces intense backlash for exploiting the murder of Henry Nowak to stoke racial tensions, with accusations of deepening divisions and promoting 'anti-white prejudice.' His inflammatory remarks have drawn criticism from political figures, including Kemi Badenoch, and sparked debates over justice and immigration policies.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to Farage’s polarizing rhetoric, which amplifies racial grievances and fuels moral panic over immigration and justice system biases.

hotspots.title: Hungary’s constitutional crisis over president’s removal
hotspots.blurb: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has threatened to amend the constitution to remove President Tamás Sulyok, appointed by former leader Viktor Orbán, after Sulyok refused to resign. This escalation has sparked accusations of authoritarianism and deepened political tensions in Hungary.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes power struggle between Magyar and Sulyok, raising concerns about democratic backsliding and constitutional integrity in Hungary.

hotspots.title: PP and Vox coalition talks intensify in Spain
hotspots.blurb: Negotiations between Spain’s conservative People’s Party (PP) and far-right Vox party are accelerating to form regional governments in Castilla y León and Andalusia. The talks highlight Vox’s growing influence and the PP’s strategic maneuvering to secure power amid political fragmentation.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the high-stakes coalition talks, which could reshape Spain’s political landscape and signal a shift toward far-right governance in key regions.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s governance and economic policies under scrutiny
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei faces mounting criticism over his economic policies, including mass layoffs, inflation, and declining public support. His confrontational style and controversial reforms have sparked protests, internal government disputes, and international scrutiny.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to Milei’s radical economic reforms, which have polarized Argentina and raised concerns about social stability and democratic governance.

hotspots.title: AfD’s internal leadership battles intensify
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party faces internal turmoil, including expulsions, surveillance by intelligence agencies, and debates over alliances with other far-right groups. The party’s rising popularity in polls has heightened concerns about its extremist tendencies and potential to gain power in upcoming state elections.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to the AfD’s growing influence in German politics, its extremist rhetoric, and the broader implications for democracy and social cohesion in Germany.
